entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: An elf and former planeswalker, Prince of Kaldheim and younger brother of King Harald, a boastful close-combat fighter who transmutes natural substances; he lost his spark in the Great Desparkening.

entities.name: King Harald
entities.description: Tyvar's older brother, uniter of Kaldheim's two groups of elves.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: A planeswalker who allies with Tyvar against Tibalt and kills Varragoth.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: A planeswalker disguised as the god Valki who causes the Doomskar; later a compleated Phyrexian planeswalker killed by Tyvar.

entities.name: Varragoth
entities.description: A demon who leads the demons through the Doomskar rift and seeks the Sword of the Realms; killed by Kaya.

entities.name: Arni
entities.description: A companion who flies with Tyvar and Kaya and stays behind to slow zombies.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: A god who advises the clan leaders to take the Sword of the Realms to Halvar.

entities.name: Halvar
entities.description: The god of battle who can end the Doomskar.

entities.name: Koma
entities.description: The cosmos serpent of Kaldheim for whom all elves share reverence.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who calls for help against New Phyrexia and is infected and impaled by Elspeth.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Found wounded and infected with Phyresis in Sheoldred's Coliseum.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: An infected planeswalker who sacrifices herself and is later sent to Zendikar.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A planeswalker who fights Ajani with Tyvar, then impales Jace with Luxior.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A compleated planeswalker who confronts the strike team.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker on the strike team and on the Duskmourn expedition.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Phyrexian praetor who activates Realmbreaker and begins the invasion.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A newly compleated planeswalker who arrives with Norn.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: A companion in Duskmourn from Arcavios who studies the library and later brings Tyvar to Strixhaven.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: A character whom the group seeks to find and save on Duskmourn.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A planeswalker on the Duskmourn expedition, captured by the cult.

entities.name: Marina Vendrell
entities.description: A teenage girl in the House whose actions enabled Valgavoth.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: An entity who has taken over Duskmourn, growing through Marina's actions.

entities.name: Dean Kianne
entities.description: Zimone's deceased mentor, whose apparition is a trick of the House.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: Tyvar's home plane, of ten realms, where the Doomskar occurs.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian plane the planeswalker strike team infiltrates.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: A plane dominated by the House and Valgavoth.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: A device the strike team sought to deactivate and Norn activates to begin the interplanar Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Sylex
entities.description: A device carried by Jace toward the Seedcore and lost when Elspeth disappears with it.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: A collision of realms created by Tibalt through a giant rift in Immersturm.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The interplanar Phyrexian invasion begun when Realmbreaker is activated.

entities.name: Great Desparkening
entities.description: The aftermath event in which Tyvar lost his spark.

events.summary: Tibalt, disguised as Valki, advises King Harald to prepare for war; Tyvar grows suspicious and investigates.
events.quote: Suspicious of this "Valki", Tyvar began to follow and investigate the god through the realms.

events.summary: Tyvar rescues Kaya at Gnottvold by turning the Torga trolls to stone, and they decide to stop Tibalt together.
events.quote: The elf helped Kaya by defeating the trolls, turning them into stone.

events.summary: Tibalt creates a Doomskar and thousands of demons led by Varragoth stream through a rift to attack another realm.
events.quote: they were unable to prevent Tibalt from creating a Doomskar

events.summary: Tyvar, Kaya and Arni fly toward Halvar with the Sword of the Realms but are attacked by Varragoth and fall near the Dread Marn.
events.quote: were attacked in midair by the demon Varragoth who wanted the Sword for himself

events.summary: Kaya cuts Varragoth's throat with one of Tyvar's axes, ending the Doomskar; Tyvar resolves to walk the Multiverse.
events.quote: the demon was only stopped by Kaya, who cut the demon's throat with one of the axes Tyvar had made for her

events.summary: Tyvar answers Jace's call and joins the planeswalker strike team to deactivate Realmbreaker on New Phyrexia.
events.quote: As part of the planeswalker strike team to deactivate Realmbreaker , Tyvar travelled to New Phyrexia.

events.summary: Jace reacts adversely to Halo and, fixated on helping Vraska, abandons the group, carrying the Sylex.
events.quote: Abandoning the group, he set out to find her.

events.summary: Vraska, infected, infects Jace; Nahiri sacrifices herself to blow up the Coliseum, dropping the group onto the Fair Basilica.
events.quote: Vraska succumbed to the Phyrexian influence and infected Jace in turn.

events.summary: Tyvar kills Tibalt by stabbing him through the chest while Elspeth fights Ajani.
events.quote: ultimately claiming victory by stabbing him through his chest cavity with his barbed tails

events.summary: Elspeth impales Jace with Luxior and disappears with the Sylex.
events.quote: only to see Elspeth impale Jace with Luxior and disappear alongside the Sylex

events.summary: Elesh Norn, Tamiyo and compleated Nissa arrive and Norn activates Realmbreaker, beginning the interplanar invasion.
events.quote: she activated Realmbreaker and began the interplanar Phyrexian invasion

events.summary: The three survivors escape after seeing Nahiri sent to Zendikar, and tell Liliana, Chandra and Wrenn.
events.quote: Norn wanted them to tell their allies of their inescapable fate.

events.summary: Tyvar and Harald lead the defense of Skemfar and Kaldheim; Tyvar slays a Phyrexian serpent and is desparked in the Great Desparkening.
events.quote: Tyvar was desparked in the Great Desparkening

events.summary: Tyvar joins the Duskmourn expedition to find and save Nashi.
events.quote: Tyvar joined Kaito Shizuki , Niko Aris , the Wanderer , and Zimone Wola in their efforts to find and save Nashi from the plane of Duskmourn .

events.summary: Tyvar and Zimone are separated in the shifting library, attacked by a cellarspawn, and flee a regenerating spider-like creature.
events.quote: a grotesque, spider-like creature emerged from the twisting space, attacking Tyvar

events.summary: Tyvar is disemboweled by a horror, discharging his fateshifter; he and Zimone nearly lose themselves in the House's camouflage.
events.quote: Tyvar was briefly disemboweled by the horror, discharging his fateshifter

events.summary: Zimone and Tyvar meet Marina Vendrell and find her diary showing she enabled Valgavoth to take over the plane.
events.quote: Through her actions, Marina had enabled Valgavoth to grow and consume everything around him

events.summary: Tyvar and Zimone rescue Nashi, Niko and the Wanderer from the cult and escape through an Omenpath opened by Kaito.
events.quote: Tyvar and Zimone rescued Nashi, Niko, and the Wanderer, who had been captured

events.summary: Tyvar accompanies Zimone to Arcavios to see Strixhaven University.
events.quote: Tyvar accompanied Zimone to her home plane of Arcavios

relations.quote: The younger brother of King Harald

relations.note: together they decided to stop Tibalt
relations.quote: Together, the two decided to work to investigate and stop Tibalt's plans.
